description: Get a free, higher-rate-limit (40r/s vs the 5r/s anonymous default) API key for a site that links back to scanhood.xyz. ScanHood fetches the site itself and checks for a real <a> to scanhood.xyz before issuing a key — self-reported claims are rejected. One key per site; re-applying with the same site returns the existing key.

site.description: URL of the site that links back to scanhood.xyz, e.g. "https://example.com"

name: apply_partner_key
title: Apply for a free ScanHood partner API key
